author: Komorebi P.
edition_title: Packet Operator Algorithms, Exact Compilation, and GPU Realization
source_branches: Complete v0.6.0 finite release, all six mathematical completion supplements and amendments, full strengthened Annals manuscript and numerical companion, and exact worked visual appendix.
series_scope: 56 registered manuscript-proved finite items under their individual hypotheses; 392 theorem declarations across 40 active modules, including 19 reused foundation declarations, plus 66 separately audited constructions. Four classical inputs remain separately tracked. Full strengthened manuscript and substantive mathematics of all six supplements retained. No fresh Lean compilation or GPU measurement.

formal_scope.qualification: Exact hypotheses belong to each item. Small-core optimality uses supplied ordered thin-SVD equations, with actual compact input ranges and arbitrary ambient competitors. General SVD existence, numerical QR/SVD computation and canonical singular-values API identification are outside this independent formal scope.

unavailable_fresh_gates: Lean compilation and deliberate compiler rejection controls
Original SymPy visual-example suite and original SymPy figure generator
limitations: Finite exact examples, numerical mirrors, static source/evidence consistency, written proof review, inherited kernel evidence and historical device observations are distinct evidence. The sanitized benchmark archive lacks complete source-value and correctness-reference provenance; cross-scope ratios are descriptive recorded comparisons. No generic dense-matrix exponent, unrestricted discovery theorem, bit-complexity bound or CUDA-kernel verification is claimed.
raw_source_policy: Both original ZIPs and all 1,062 extracted files are preserved byte-for-byte. Editorial corrections occur only in final companions and explicit audit records.

written_preservation.scope: The supplements retain complete prose constructions and proofs beyond the 56 explicit manuscript proof environments. Counts overlap conceptually and are not discovery counts.

fresh_checks.scope: Bounded tests, examples and static checks. Archived ratio arithmetic is not hardware replication or full contract authentication.

open_broader_research_targets: Compilation with nonlocal overlapping candidate models
Packet-native communication bounds for a specified architecture
